verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API docs say developers can 'listen for events with webhooks' and include dedicated webhook endpoints to create and manage them. The docs give concrete file events such as new comments and version-history additions, and plan access tokens support user-agnostic webhooks for CI/CD. Missing for 10: a full list of event types and payload/delivery details (retries, signature verification), and independent or hands-on confirmation that webhooks work as documented.
